title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 36
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 36: the scroll Baruch wrote and read aloud, the king who cut it up and burned it, and the second scroll written afterwards.

questions.text: In which year of Jehoiakim did this word come to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh.

answers.text: In the first year of Jehoiakim
In the fourth year of Jehoiakim
In the ninth year of Jehoiakim
In the eleventh year of Jehoiakim

questions.text: Who wrote Yahweh's words on the scroll from the mouth of Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all Yahweh's words on a scroll of a book.

answers.text: Elishama the scribe
Jehudi the son of Nethaniah
Micaiah the son of Gemariah
Baruch the son of Neriah

questions.text: What reason did Jeremiah give Baruch for not going into Yahweh's house himself?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, "I am restricted. I can't go into Yahweh's house."

answers.text: He said he was restricted and could not go there
He said the princes had sent him away
He said he was keeping the fast at home
He said he had gone to the land of Benjamin

questions.text: In whose room did Baruch read the words of Jeremiah to all the people?
questions.explanation: Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in Yahweh's house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan, the scribe, in the upper court.

answers.text: In the room of Elishama the scribe
In the room of the sons of Hanan
In the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan
In the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum

questions.text: Who heard all Yahweh's words out of the book and went down to tell the princes?
questions.explanation: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard all Yahweh's words out of the book, he went down to the scribe's room and declared them to the princes.

answers.text: Jehudi the son of Nethaniah
Micaiah the son of Gemariah
Elnathan the son of Achbor
Delaiah the son of Shemaiah

questions.text: How did the princes react when they had heard all the words Baruch read?
questions.explanation: When they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another and said to Baruch that they would surely tell the king of all these words.

answers.text: They tore their garments and wept
They sent Baruch away in anger
They laughed and would not believe him
They feared, and said they would tell the king

questions.text: How did Baruch say the words came to be in the book?
questions.explanation: Baruch answered that Jeremiah dictated all these words to him with his mouth, and that he wrote them with ink in the book.

answers.text: Jeremiah dictated them, and he wrote them with ink
He copied them from an older book
He wrote what the princes told him to write
He remembered them from the fast day

questions.text: What did the princes tell Baruch to do after they had heard the scroll?
questions.explanation: The princes said to Baruch, "You and Jeremiah go hide. Don't let anyone know where you are."

answers.text: To read the scroll again to the people
To bring the scroll to the king himself
To go and hide with Jeremiah, telling no one
To carry the scroll out of the city

questions.text: What did the king do with the scroll as Jehudi read it?
questions.explanation: When Jehudi had read three or four leaves, the king cut it with the penknife and cast it into the fire in the brazier until all the scroll was consumed.

answers.text: He sealed it and put it in an earthen vessel
He cut it with the penknife and threw it into the fire
He gave it back to Elishama the scribe
He read it aloud to all the princes

questions.text: Who made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll?
questions.explanation: Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll, but he would not listen to them.

answers.text: Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah
Jerahmeel, Seraiah and Shelemiah
Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet
Jehudi and Elishama the scribe
